edit.description.md:
Setup (username, editor, auto sync, emails: this machine) was one chain with init (this repository, pushed to everyone) wedged in the middle, so configuring yourself could stall on, or walk into, initializing a project.

- `epiq setup` runs only the machine questions, then quits: no board, no init offer. Rerunnable; esc quits.
- `:setup` inside epiq asks the same questions and stays in the TUI.
- Opening epiq in a git repository without a board offers one (`init` typed, enter or esc). The offer is the screen's: typing `:init` yourself doesn't change the page.
- `epiq init` starts a board from a script; it needs only an author.
- init never leaves a repository it then refuses: a failure is taken back, a board on another branch is adopted.

add.issue.comment.md: #582: `epiq setup` quits after the machine questions (no init offer); the init screen's offer is its own state, so typing `:init` yourself no longer changes the page.
